core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gohar is a Persian-origin name meaning “Jewel, gem, pearl”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gohar corresponds to the Persian form جوهر (Persian گوهر (gawhar) < Middle Persian gōhr). Its core sense is gem, jewel, essence. Gohar is the Persian گوهر (gawhar) 'jewel, gem, pearl' and, by extension, 'essence, intrinsic worth' (Middle Persian gōhr 'substance, essence'). It is the same name recorded as gauhar in the previous batch. The source labelled it 'Arabic' and glossed it 'light, radiance'; the word is Persian and its sense is 'gem/essence'.
